purpose: Test the predeclared Antarctic-specific hypothesis that newly available terrestrial breeding opportunity is translated into relative breeding use more strongly where breeding-season open water becomes more accessible.

roster.marine_intersection: Retain only H1 units whose physical site passes the frozen marine-distance measurement gate.
roster.network_rule: A species x APBP-region network must retain at least 5 units; networks falling below this threshold are removed without reference to H2 outcome.

land.standardization: z-score within species on the final H2 unit roster

marine.definition: early median open-water distance minus late median open-water distance; positive means open water became closer
marine.standardization: z-score within species on the final H2 unit roster

model.formula: y_i,t = alpha_i + delta_region,t + beta_A*z_land_i*tau_t + beta_M*z_marine_i*tau_t + beta_AM*(z_land_i*z_marine_i)*tau_t + error_i,t
model.delta_region_t: species-specific APBP-region x season fixed effect
model.tau_t: (season - mean included season for that species)/10; one unit equals one decade
model.interpretation: Positive beta_AM means the relative-use advantage associated with terrestrial opportunity gain is stronger where open water also becomes closer.
model.weighting: primary unweighted collapsed-state regression; precision-weighted refit mandatory sensitivity
model.standard_errors: cluster-robust by physical site within species

inference.species_tests: Prespecified one-sided tests beta_AM > 0 for each retained species.

permutation.scheme: Within each species x retained APBP region, permute the complete site-level marine favorable-change value among site time series while keeping land change, counts, observation schedule, site identity and region-season states fixed.
permutation.rationale: Tests whether the observed site pairing of marine change with land change and demographic trajectory carries an interaction beyond the fixed land exposure.

inference.secondary_terms: beta_A and beta_M are reported descriptively; no additional confirmatory p-values.
inference.cross_species: Report signs and median beta_AM descriptively; no pooled p-value.

mandatory_sensitivities: Repeat complete H2 model using rate_p67_per_year for land exposure.
Precision-weighted refit with the frozen collapsed observation variances.

recovery_gate.rule: Before real H2 execution, simulate the exact retained observation schedule and measured land/marine covariates with beta_AM = 0, 0.15 and 0.30 and verify unbiased recovery.
recovery_gate.outcome_values: Synthetic only; do not read real count magnitudes during recovery.

boundaries: H2 is secondary because H1 general terrestrial-opportunity tracking was not confirmed.
A positive interaction does not measure prey abundance.
Do not substitute another sea-ice threshold, month set, marine metric or nonlinear interaction after seeing H2.
Do not reinterpret a positive H2 as confirmation of the failed three-species H1 main effect.
Relative breeding use is not literal occupied guano footprint.
stop_rule: After H2 is computed, no same-data environmental covariate search is opened.
